1.description: [Area 52] [Gurubashi Berserker] Gurubashi Bloodsurge now grants 25% Armor Penetration down from 50%.
[Area 52] [Gurubashi Berserker] Gurubashi Rage now grants 20% increased rage generation down from 50%.
[Area 52] [Gurubashi Berserker] Onslaught now increases your Execute damage by 20%, from 30%.
[Area 52] [White Walker] Increased the combo point attack and spellpower scaling of Winds of Winter by 25%.
[Area 52] [Bone Arrow] Increased the base damage and scaling of the direct damage and dot portion of Bone Arrow by 20%.
[Area 52] [Wild Wrath] The Wrath damage increase from Wild Wrath is now 6% from 8% per stack, but it now also grants 6% critical strike chance per stack.
[Area 52] [Locust Ranger] Increased the ranged weapon damage of Locust Shot from 75% to 90%.
[Area 52] [Paratrooper] Reduced the weapon damage of Orbital Arrows from 100% to 85%.
[Area 52] [Dark Ranger] Fixed a bug where Explosive Shot could trigger, and consume Dark Arrow charges upon dealing damage instead of upon casting the ability.
[Area 52] [Dark Ranger] Dark Arrows now has 6 charges from 5.
[Area 52] [Dark Ranger] Increased the ranged weapon damage of Dark Arrows from 70% to 80%.
[Area 52] [Dark Ranger] Casting Shadow Artillery now increases the damage of subsequent Shadow Artillery casts by 20% for 5 seconds, stacking 3 times. This effect cannot be refreshed at 3 stacks.

[Area 52] [Dark Ranger] Shadow Artillery now lasts for 8 seconds, from 3 seconds. And the dot deals damage every 2 seconds from every 1 second. Shadow Artillery will now also increase all damage taken from the caster by 10%.
[Elune] The Spellpower and attack power scaling of the direct and damage-over-time portion of Chaos Burn has been increased by 15%.
[Elune] Fixed a bug causing the damage over time from Chaos Burn to benefit from the damage increase of Corrupted Maelstrom Weapon despite the tooltip stating that it only affects direct damage.
[Elune] Fixed a bug causing Chaos Burn to be unable to benefit from Molten Fel Core.
[Area 52][Elemental Destruction] Normalized pvp mod of Energy Bolt to be the same as Lightning Bolt: 10% reduced damage against players.
[Both Realms] Mass Razorlash: Increased the scaling of the damage over time effect by 20%.
[Both Realms] Razorlash: Increased the scaling of the damage over time effect by 20%.
[Both Realms] Crimson Tempest: Increased the scaling by 25%.
[Both Realms] Rupture: Increased the scaling by 20%.
[Both Realms] Garrote: Increased the scaling by 15%.
[Both Realms] Buffed Flowing. It now only requires 3 stacks to apply Overflowing. Down from 4.
[Both Realms] Buffed Overflow. The range of Overflow's heal is now 12 Yards. Up from 8 Yards.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Boomer was triggering additional effects.[Elune] Void Erruption Shadow Word: Pain AoE application now also works with Worgen Form.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Purification by Light was triggering additional effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Twilight Treason was triggering additional effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Righteous Zealot was triggering additional effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Inferno was triggering additional effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Frost Lich was triggering additional effects.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Consuming Flames was reducing the critical damage by 2% instead of intended 5%.
[Elune] Buffed Traumatic Wounds. Duration of Rip extend is now 2 seconds. Up form 1 second.
[Elune] Buffed Traumatic Wounds. It now also triggers its effects with Shred, Ravage and Mangle (Cat) in addition to Claw and Bloodthirst.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Traumatic Wounds enable extending the duration of Rip with any Physical ability.
[Elune] Midnight Flames now increases the damage of mentioned spells by 10%. Down from 12%.
[Elune] Buffed Midnight Flames. It now also increases the damage of your Shadowflame.
[Elune] Pyrolate now increases the damage of your Immolate by 12%. Down from 15%.
[Elune] Elemental Destruction now increases the damage of your active Immolate by 13%. Down form 15%.
[Elune] Elemental Immolate: Decreased damage by 5%.
[Elune] Astral Storm: Decreased damage by 10%.
[Elune] Temporal Haste: Decreased cast time of the next spell by 35%. Down from 40%.
[Elune] Silence in the Library and Spartan Kick no longer trigger additional procs.
[Elune] Buffed Double Down: The offhand attacks now correctly scale as much as your regular Sinister Strike.
[Elune] Sinister Flurry triggered attack no longer procs other procs.
[Elune] Buffed Sinister Flurry: The triggered attack now deals 50% more damage.
[Elune] Buffed Dark Intent: Increased scaling by 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Dark Intent: Increased base damage by 10%.
[Elune] Sinister Intent: Decreased scaling by 10%.
[Elune] Buffed Sinister Intent: Increased base damage by 10%.
[Elune] Using Sinister Strike with Dark Intent talent will now trigger Sinister Intent. This is just a copy of Dark Intent but enables separate balance for these procs.
[Elune] Buffed Biting Drain. Previously enabled your Drain Life to critically hit (thats now baseline). Now it increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Drain Life by 30%.
[Elune] Drain Life, Lingering Shadows, Unbounded Drain Life are now capable of critical hits baseline on Elune.
[Elune] Spiderbite now has a new mechanic: Spider's Harvest reduces the duration of your next drain life by 15%, but reduces the healing by 50%.
[Elune] Buffed Spiderbite. Each charge now increases the damage of the next damaging Drain Life tick by 100%.
[Elune] Necromancer’s Touch increases the damage of your next Drain Life by 25% or next Blood Arrow and Shadow Dagger by 15%.
[Elune] Harvest Essence now stacks up to 5 times. Changed from the bugged behaviour of charge system that did not work properly.
